<thought>Based on the sulfonamide formation reaction, the retrosynthetic step breaks the S–N bond, giving a sulfonyl chloride and the amine. The amine precursor is the aniline "c1ccccc1N". The corresponding sulfonyl chloride derived from the sulfonamide part is "Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1". Thus the only plausible precursor pair is these two SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1\", \"c1ccccc1N\"]]</final_answer>
